mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage (user_id, usage_date, request_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_count = IF(request_count < #{limit}, request_count + 1, request_count)

INSERT INTO ai_usage (user_id, usage_date, request_count, token_estimate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, 0, #{tokens}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_estimate = ai_usage.token_estimate + incoming.token_estimate
